qualifier: ligand secretion, receptor-level regulation and calcium branch
name: Wnt ligand secretion, receptor regulation and calcium branch
rationale: All members concern Wnt signaling at the ligand/receptor/DVL level; unlike the canonical destruction-complex confusables, the theme has WNT secretion (PORCN, Golgi), FZD/ROR2 regulation and the non-canonical Ca2+ pathway.

name: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and positioning
rationale: Members cover mitotic NPC disassembly and reformation, pore localization and gene tethering at the nuclear periphery, as opposed to confusables about nucleocytoplasmic cargo transport or lamina/envelope remodeling.

qualifier: proliferation and co-stimulation (ICOS, CD27, Tfh help)
name: B cell activation, proliferation and co-stimulation
rationale: Members are B cell signatures, BCR signaling, B cell proliferation/differentiation and ICOS/CD27/Tfh co-stimulation, distinguishing it from confusables centered on plasma cells, immunoglobulins and B cell homeostasis.

name: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration
rationale: Every member regulates VSMC proliferation, migration, differentiation, apoptosis or phenotypic switching, whereas confusables concern endothelial activation and vessel remodeling.

name: Iron uptake with ascorbate and antioxidant vitamin response
rationale: Members combine iron import/homeostasis with vitamin C metabolism, vitamin E/selenium responses and superoxide removal; the ascorbate/antioxidant component separates it from heme, transferrin and other-metal confusables.

name: Monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis via CCR2/CX3CR1
rationale: Members regulate monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and activation, anchored by CCR2/CX3CR1 modules, unlike generic chemokine clusters or monocyte surface signatures in confusables.

name: Neuroblast proliferation and forebrain dorsoventral patterning
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/progenitor division, stem cell maintenance and neuron differentiation together with forebrain morphogenesis and patterning (incl. adenohypophysis), unlike confusables on neuronal migration, glial fate or catecholaminergic neurons.

name: Photoreceptor phototransduction and retinal neuron development
rationale: Members cover opsins and the phototransduction cascade plus photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation and maintenance, distinct from retinoid-cycle and eye-morphogenesis confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, differentiation, stress hypertrophy and regeneration, unlike confusables on skeletal myogenesis, calcineurin signaling or heart morphogenesis.

name: Serotonin and muscarinic receptor signaling with cAMP degradation
rationale: Members are serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine GPCR/channel signaling plus cAMP catabolism (CaM-PDE1), the latter distinguishing it from serotonin synthesis, nicotinic and tachykinin confusables.

name: Radial glia-guided neuronal migration and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members concern radial migration, cortical layering and dentate gyrus development plus corpus callosum/anterior commissure morphogenesis, as opposed to tangential interneuron migration in confusables.

name: RNA polymerase I transcription initiation and rDNA chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover Pol I preinitiation, promoter opening/escape and B-WICH/NoRC control of rRNA expression, distinct from confusables on Pol I elongation/termination, rRNA processing or Pol III machinery.

qualifier: processing, incretin-stimulated secretion and GLUT4 translocation
name: Insulin processing, incretin-stimulated secretion and GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members span insulin processing and catabolism, GLP-1/GIP-stimulated secretion and insulin-driven GLUT4 translocation/receptor recycling, unlike confusables on K-ATP/fatty-acid secretion control or insulin receptor signaling.

qualifier: ER protein targeting, folding and ER-Golgi vesicle transport
name: ER protein targeting, folding and ER-Golgi vesicle transport
rationale: Members cover SRP/tail-anchored ER insertion, ER folding and quality control, COPII/COPI ER-Golgi traffic and connexin secretion, distinguishing it from UPR-signaling and Golgi/endosomal traffic confusables.

qualifier: spindle checkpoint and contractile ring cytokinesis
name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and cytokinetic contractile ring formation
rationale: Members cover spindle assembly, kinetochore attachment, spindle checkpoint and actomyosin/septin cytokinesis, unlike confusables on centrosome/AURKA, abscission or chromosome cohesion.

qualifier: ncRNA translational silencing, stabilization and splicing repression
name: ncRNA translational silencing, mRNA stabilization and splicing repression
rationale: Members concern miRNA/lncRNA/ceRNA translational silencing, IGF2BP/CRD mRNA stabilization and negative regulation of splicing, unlike confusables on small RNA biogenesis or mRNA decay machinery.

name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and destruction complex cancer mutants
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin phosphorylation, the AXIN/APC/AMER1 destruction complex and its oncogenic mutants, and TCF target regulation, distinguishing it from non-canonical/secretion Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog confusables.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction, relaxation and arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, vasoconstriction and systemic/pulmonary blood pressure, unlike confusables centered on eNOS/NO-cGMP production or adrenergic receptor signaling.

qualifier: TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing via MyD88-IRAK4
name: TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing and MyD88-dependent inflammation
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide/LTA detection, TLR2/4 regulation, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and monocyte inflammatory modules, distinct from inflammasome and NOD-receptor confusables.

name: Myogenesis restraint, satellite cell maintenance and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation, satellite cell maintenance and inactivity-induced atrophy, unlike confusables on myogenic differentiation and cardiac muscle growth.

qualifier: atypical MAPKs, TORC2 and serine phosphorylation
name: Growth kinase signaling: atypical MAPKs, TORC2, serine phosphorylation
rationale: Members share growth-factor/nutrient kinase signaling (ERK5, MAPK4/6, RAS, TORC2, serine phosphorylation, growth-control modules), distinct from confusables about ERK inactivation and MAPK negative feedback.

name: Craniofacial, limb and pharyngeal gland embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover face, skull, palate, ear and limb morphogenesis plus thymus/thyroid/parathyroid/pituitary/spleen development, distinguishing it from inner ear, neural plate and outflow tract confusables.

name: Somitogenesis and Hox-mediated anteroposterior axial patterning
rationale: Members are somite specification, segmentation clock (LFNG), axis elongation and Hox cluster modules, unlike confusables on neural plate, hindbrain or limb patterning.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst and ROS-mediated bacterial killing
rationale: Members regulate superoxide/ROS generation, the respiratory burst and PMN killing of bacteria, unlike confusables on degranulation, macrophage modules or antifungal responses.

qualifier: IL-12-driven NKT and Th1 cytokine production
name: IL-12-driven Th1 and NKT cell activation, IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members cover IL-12 production/signaling, Th1 cytokines, IFN-gamma/GM-CSF production and NKT activation, distinct from confusables on IFN-gamma response, MHC induction and Treg/Th differentiation.
